comments.author: Elroyy
comments.body:
Chain quests in Alexandria:
Premise: discovery of Abu Simbel Temple.
1st quest need of R8 Art, R5 Theo and Ancient Egyptian.
2nd quest need of Arabic only.
3rd quest need of Arabic, R4 Appraisal and R2 Search.

PS: The 1st quest of chain is part of requirement for quest job of Ruin Explorer.
